title: Cigar & Spirit Tasting | Padron
seo_title: Cigar & Spirit Tasting with Padron in Ozark, MO
description: This is a holiday edition of the Cigar & Spirit Tasting at Vineyard Market, featuring Padron cigars and a selection of spirits. There may be a Best Santa Claus Contest, so guests are invited to wear a Santa outfit. It takes place Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 6:00 PM at 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO; tickets are $65, and reservations are available by phone at (417) 882-0399 or online.
